description: Stage 1 — improves raw text in its own language (grammar, word choice, flow, clarity) without changing meaning or translating it; correctionsOnly limits it to spelling, grammar and punctuation. Use before translate_text when the input is rough.

correctionsOnly.description: Write mode: true fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation only; omitted or false improves the whole text (word choice, flow, clarity). Applies to optimize_text and to format "Optimize".
